name: object_anims
verifies: fix-61: the used object's own part of the hero's use motions (Faring grindstone wheel + pedal, barbecue spit, chest lid) and the motion-track sounds of the uses (grindstone wheel/pedal/sword + sparks, barbecue squeak, anvil, cauldron, chest open/close)
steps: log fix-72 (R35-1): the grindstone and the anvil stand in the Faring castle courtyard (zone a4de440f, Enclave): Faring enclave fame 75 keeps the hero from being an intruder there (safe gives only Orc political fame)
log fix-67 (R33-4): the lower-town grindstones are Goran's and Merc_09's work places by day (one user per object, fix-66), the one in Zakosh's smithy is nobody's routine point, so it is free at noon

log fix-65 (R32-3): a free chest - the one below Faring at (566.2, 47.9, 582.7) lies in no AI zone, so opening it is no theft (G3 IsBotheredByPlayerTheftOf), unlike the Faring house chest next to Ali (a UseInteractObject crime)
log fix-66: Zakosh works this anvil by day and G3 lets one user at an anvil, at 21:00 he leaves it
notes: Needs `Myrtana/Content/Build interactive visuals` after fix-61 (grindstone, barbecue and chest prefabs get their _I_ parts; output git-ignored). objpart = the used object's animation ('Playing <part>' during the use, 'Resting <part>' after it, '-' for plain meshes such as the anvil). sfx:<effect> counts motion-track sounds since the domain loaded. A station or chest 'use' returns once the loop runs with its page open; closepage ends the use. Listen at the grindstone: wheel grinding + pedal squeaks every 2 s with sparks at the blade, the wheel turns while used and stops with the End motion; the chest lid opens with the kneeling hero and shuts with OpenChest_End.
